relations.subject: Kenneth Ken'ichi Tanaka
relations.evidence: In 1991 Tanaka was appointed the Rev. Yoshitaka Tamai Professor at the Institute of Buddhist Studies, an affiliate of the Graduate Theological Union at Berkeley, California.

relations.subject: Kenneth Ken'ichi Tanaka
relations.evidence: In 1998 he became professor of Buddhist Studies at Musashino University in Tokyo, Japan.
